United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

title.narrative: 42C/5 OUTPUT 1 Member Stated capacities strengthened to advance effective policies

description.narrative: To strengthen the capacities of MS to advance policies to achieve inclusive societies through the promotion of HR, gender equality, scientific freedom, intercultural understanding and antidiscrimination and antiracism, UNESCO will produce knowledge and evidence, reinforce skills and competences, raise awareness and bolster outreach. Aligned with the Global Call Against Racism and the Roadmap Against Racism, it will support the reinforcement of legal frameworks, policies and institutions relying on the scanning study and benchmarks, and the deployment of the antiracism toolkit. Consolidate the Annual Global Forum on Anti-racism as "the place to be" to address challenges and convene experts and actors. Action to change mindsets for intercultural and antiracist competences will be undertaken. Art residency programmes and learning materials will be enhanced based on the history of slavery through research and knowledge production. Arts will be mainstreamed in development contexts as a vehicle for social justice, rights and dialogue. Outreach and good practices will be promoted through the intercultural dialogue e-Platform. Deployment of the Global Index for Intercultural Dialogue will advance mutual understanding and peace. Increased actions to promote and protect the right to science (including mechanisms, operational guidance, capacity and advocacy) based on the 2017 Rec. on Science and Scientific Researchers. The application of HRBA will be strengthened within all actions.
